latest_release.name: v1.0.7
latest_release.body:
Eigent v1.0.7 lets you work with several Sessions at once, side by side or in their own windows, adds a Session menu and message actions, and makes Automations start reliably, once, and on your local time.

This update also fixes a long list of bugs found in testing and reported by the community, from approvals and quitting to sign-in after an update.

### Highlights

- **Sessions side by side** — Show up to three Sessions next to each other in a Space, or open a Session in its own window or browser tab. Background work such as scheduled Automations starts from only one window, so nothing runs twice.
- **Session menu** — Click the Session title to pin, rename, end or delete it, or turn the Session into a skill or an Automation.
- **Message actions** — Copy a message, edit and resend it, or expand a long one. A divider shows when the model changes between tasks.
- **Space overview** — See an overview of the Space in a panel beside the Workspace composer.
- **Redesigned Dispatch page** — The Remote Control page has a new layout.
- **BytePlus ModelArk sub-agents** — Add BytePlus ModelArk managed agents as a remote sub-agent provider from a redesigned Settings → Sub-agents page.
- **Out of credits, not out of options** — When your Eigent credits run out, upgrade your plan or switch to your own API key straight from the notice.

### Automations

- Run now starts the Automation right away, and runs the app never received are recovered.
- Automations are listed for the whole Space, and their schedules stay in your local time.
- An Automation runs only once when you open its Session afterwards.

### Approvals, questions and tasks

- Approvals and questions appear above the message box and name the file or command they are for.
- A question still waiting after a reload can be answered, and the agent's question and your answer stay in the chat.
- Memory changes ask for confirmation and show their details.
- Follow-up messages wait in the queue until a failed task is resolved.
- Resumed tasks keep their browser tools.
- Interrupted tasks show the actions they completed and the files they wrote.
- The agent knows the current date and time on every task.
- A Session that was refused keeps showing its error after a reload.
- A new Session opens as soon as you press Send.

### Quitting, updates and models

- Eigent asks before quitting whenever a task is starting, running or waiting for you, and cleans up each task's terminal environment.
- After an update you stay signed in, and Eigent reopens your last Space.
- Picking a model inside a Session changes it for that Space only, not your default for new Spaces.

### Interface

- A wider chat column, aligned message insets and composer controls, and a query that stays anchored while the reply streams.
- Scroll to bottom in the floating chat control, and a Session summary column next to the preview.
- PDF previews show the file name and fit the page.
- Dates use the app language, icons share one line weight, scrollbars look the same everywhere, and tooltips close when a dialog opens.

**Full changelog:** [v1.0.6 → v1.0.7](https://github.com/eigent-ai/eigent/compare/v1.0.6...v1.0.7)
